ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High. Visible surface is approximately 90% high-intensity white pixels with a 10% low-intensity black distribution primarily at the trailing edge and lateral tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white central field. Continuous low-intensity black perimeter mapping along the entire trailing edge. One distinct circular low-intensity blob located near the vertical midline at the lower visible boundary. Multiple small (2-5 pixel) low-intensity focal spots clustered on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression, vertex angle measured at approximately 50-60 degrees, depth ratio is ~0.15 relative to vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serration across entire span. Peak-to-valley pixel amplitude ranges from 5 to 15 pixels. Edge profile exhibits a jagged 'sawtooth' pattern with approximately 25-30 distinct peaks across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex curve from the lateral tips to the median notch, heavily modulated by high-amplitude serration.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several localized low-intensity circular clusters on the inner right lobe. One prominent isolated circular low-intensity mark on the lower central white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One vertical low-intensity linear disruption approximately 15 pixels in length extending from a trailing edge valley on the right lobe towards the center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregular tissue loss across the trailing edge creating a jagged, non-biological symmetry, particularly pronounced on the left lobe's outer quadrant.
other_distinctive_markers: The amplitude of the serrations on the leftmost visible edge is significantly higher than typical species-average morphology, forming finger-like projections.
